thread:
sam_csm: Heads-up: Meridian Labs renewal in 6 weeks. They're happy with feature coverage but flagged rising costs and a few p95 latency spikes during peak biz hours. Proposing a short canary: switch 10% traffic to an int8 quant of m-meridian-v3 and route non-critical batch/embedding jobs to m-small-lite. Need engineering + SRE sign-off and a customer OK.

nina_cs: They'll want a clear savings estimate and rollback window. Can you give numbers? Also capture in Gainsight.

sam_csm: Snapshot: last week p50 140ms, p95 480ms, spikes to 1.1s under >70 concurrent. Cost ~ $380 / 1M tokens. Estimate int8 -> ~35% compute cost savings; median latency +15ms but throughput increases so queueing drops. Tail likely improves but we'll validate.

raj_engineer: I can build m-meridian-v3:int8 and run our regression suite on their 150-sample set. Plan: 48h canary @10% with automated metrics (similarity delta, error rate) + manual spot checks. Regression threshold: max_delta_metric <= 0.02 and pass_rate >= 0.9.

kai_sre: From infra: bump min replicas for canary pool to avoid cold autoscale. Add short-term routing rule to steer batch jobs to m-small-lite. I'll add alert: p95 > 700ms OR error_rate > 0.5% -> trigger rollback.

raj_engineer: Canary deploy command: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy --customer meridian --model m-meridian-v3:int8 --route canary --weight 0.10 --tag meridian-canary-2026-03
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployed (id: md-canary-1a3). Weight 10%. Region: eu-central-1.

sam_csm: Draft message to customer: "We propose a 48h, 10% canary using a quantized variant to reduce unit costs by ~30-40%. We'll monitor automated and manual quality checks and will rollback within 30 minutes if thresholds breach." Thoughts?

nina_cs: Solid. Add explicit mention we'll log results in the renewal packet and share sample diffs. I'll make the Gainsight entry.

kai_sre: I've set autoscale min=4 for the canary pool and enabled prefix caching for repeated assistant contexts. Alerts are live.

raj_engineer: Running regression now, ETA ~6h. Early local run: pass 138/150, avg_similarity 0.979, max_delta 0.015. Some formatting variance on long code blocks.

sam_csm: Thanks team. Action items: raj -> full eval + attach diffs (ETA 6h). kai -> confirm infra (ETA 1h). nina -> update Gainsight + customer note (ETA 3h). We'll reconvene 24h after canary start. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
